blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Authorities rescued a 5-year-old girl and arrested her mother and the woman’s live-in partner for allegedly exploiting the child online for profit, the National Bureau of Investigation in Central Visayas (NBI-7) said Monday. NBI-7 agents arrested the 25-year-old woman and her partner during a raid at a house in Sitio Tambisan, Barangay Tisa, Cebu City on Sept. 30. NBI-7, Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) Manila, the Inter-Agency Council Against Trafficking (IACAT), and the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) led the joint operation.
